style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
motion_rule: the camera orbits him without stopping and reverses at 2.70, 4.85 and 7.35, so the marble hall and the crowd tear past behind him; he lunges a full body length and throws his whole body into one big swing in EVERY beat, never working a prop in place; ONE pigeon cashier flies through the lens in EVERY beat; new shot size every beat, the camera never holds; he fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in
character: a male spotted hyena in a loose shirt and a pulled-down tie, teeth bared, fur ruffled
second_characters: ONE pigeon cashier in a green visor, within a wing of the lens, hauling a tray in every beat
props: ONE big net he swings all clip; ONE fat banknote the cashier flings to him at 4.85; every banknote is blank on both sides, no printing on it
prop_continuity: the net stays in his paws to the last frame; the fat note is in his paws from 4.85 until it bursts at 7.35; banknotes burst into white steam and never into scraps
environment: a bank hall at noon, tall windows, white daylight, marble counters, banknotes flying through the whole hall

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, flat and even, 3.1 syllables per second
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-4.10 one breath, breath at 4.10, 4.10-7.35 one breath; after 7.35 steam hissing and paper rustling
audio.pronunciation: zar-PLA-ta, pri-SHLA, is-pa-RI-las, SHTO-by, iz-be-ZHAT, ot-VET-stven-nos-ti
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable in every spoken beat, head to the lens, nothing in his mouth, never a voice over
audio.sfx: steam hissing, paper rustling, the net whistling, a burst at 7.35

timeline.a: chest-up, already mid-swing: he sweeps the net through a swarm of banknotes and every one it touches bursts into white steam
he hurls the netful of steam over his shoulder, the empty mesh snapping at the lens
he lunges across the counter and rakes an armful of notes off it, they steam away in his arms
he claps both paws on a note in mid-air and it blows apart into steam straight into the camera
he whips the net round overhead and slams it down on the counter, steam blasting out sideways
the cashier swoops through the lens and flings a fat banknote at him, he snatches it out of the air with both paws
he holds the fat note out at arm's length into the lens and shakes it hard, the hall streaming past behind him
the note bursts into a blast of white steam in his paws, into the lens, his empty paws open and his face to the camera
chest-up: he turns his empty paws over at the lens and blows the last steam off them
he sweeps the whole counter clean with one arm and the notes go up in steam over his head
he flings the empty net wide open at the camera, grinning, steam still rolling past

must_appear: the first word is heard at 0.0; opens mid-swing with banknotes bursting into steam, chest-up; the cashier crosses the lens in every beat; at 4.85 the cashier flings him the fat note; at 7.35 the note bursts into steam into the lens
negative_prompt: a silent opening, a still last second, a hero standing with arms down, a hero riding anything, a rolling belt, a cart, a hero seen from behind, a bowed head in a spoken beat, a parked camera, a still background, an inscription, a label, a stamp, printed words on props, digits, cyrillic, latin letters, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, letterbox, a horizontal frame, speech after 7.35
